memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse—the blessing if you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today; the curse if you disobey the commands of the Lord your God and turn from the way that I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known. - Deut 11:26-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses sets a clear choice before the people: blessing or curse, life with God or life turning away from Him. He does not leave them in vague uncertainty; he lays out the two paths plainly. The path of loving obedience leads to blessing; the path of turning away to other gods leads to ruin. This was the covenant reality for Israel, and Moses wanted them to see clearly that their choices mattered, and that the two roads led to very different destinations.

There is something clarifying about being shown a real choice. We often drift through life as if our decisions have no weight, as if we can serve God and idols at the same time without consequence. But Moses cuts through that fog. There really are two ways to live — toward God or away from Him — and they lead to very different ends. God, in His love, sets the choice before us plainly so that we might choose well.

Jesus spoke of two roads too — a narrow way that leads to life and a broad way that leads to destruction (Matt 7:13-14). And He made clear that He Himself is "the way" (John 14:6). The ultimate blessing is not merely a set of good outcomes but Christ Himself, and the path of life is the path of following Him. This is not about earning God's love through our choices, but about the direction of our whole lives. Which way are you facing? God sets the choice before you today, and in His grace He also gives the power to choose Him. Turn toward Him, and walk the path of life.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do I live as if my choices have weight, or as if they don't matter?
- Which "way" is my life currently facing — toward God or away from Him?
- How does Jesus being "the way" shape the choice before me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You set the choice of blessing and life before me. Thank You that Jesus is the way, and that following Him is the path of true blessing. Turn my heart toward You, and by Your grace give me the power to choose You each day. Amen.
